work.description: The eleventh volume of the second series of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing Sulpitius Severus, the Commonitory of Vincent of Lerins, and the works of John Cassian in English, with the volume editors' introductions. Its container identity remains distinct from the individual authors' works printed within it.
